sections.text:
Condenser 
out of Operation

Replacement 
of Damaged Condenser Tubes

Preparation of workplace secure 
 the workplace with respect to protection and safety of labor. Provide the 
 connection of electric power and compressed air, ensure lighting inside the 
 condenser with 24 V voltage. Take-over the tools, displace auxiliary 
 material in the workplace, arrange the erection of scaffolding, prepare new 
 tubes to the place of installation .

Discharge cooling water from the condenser 
 water spaces , discharge condensate from the steam space .

Open the condenser by loosening the flanged 
 joints and open the covers of water headers. perform the opening of water 
 headers step by step , according to the place of replacement of the damaged 
 tubes .

Dismantling of defective tubes tap down 
 the expanded end of tube in one tube plate and eject the tube. Take steps to 
 ensure the prevention of the damaging of openings in the tube at the tube 
 ejecting and its tapping down. After the dismantling of the damaged tubes 
 clean all the openings in the tube plates and check whether there are no 
 longitudinal grooves in them .

sections.text: تقتيش
Preparation of new tubes.

Check the cleanliness of the surface of tubes , the smoothness of the surface 
 the tube must be without deformations by depressing , without transversal 
 and longitudinal cracks , rubbings , corrosion spots , larger slivers , 
 bubbles or larger metallic inclusions on the surface

Check the length of tubes , whether they correspond to the necessary assembly 
 length of the condenser . Tubes for the steam-air mixture coolers are of 
 different material mostly , the avoiding of their interchanging with the 
 remaining tubes must be ensured

sections.text: حَشد

Assembly of new tubes clean the tube 
 perfectly, prior to its insertion into the tube plate in the places of 
 expansion, by emery cloth , along the tube diameter, not longitudinally. 
 insert the tube into the openings in the tube plates, expand the tube end in 
 the front tube plate, shorten the other end of the tube and expand the tube 
 in the rear tube plate. Drift the expanded ends, level them with the tube 
 plate and chamfer the edges by angle cutter .
Clean the condenser water spaces

Test of steam space arrest the supporting 
 springs of the condenser by the turning of the supporting nuts, fill the 
 steam space with water so that all tubes replaced were under water level. 
 check the tightness of the steam space and the quality of the expansion of the 
 individual tubes. Upon the inspection preformed discharge water from the 
 steam space and loosen the supporting spring down the nuts to the original 
 position .

 ضيق مساحة ماء المكثف عند وضع ماء التبريد 
 الدائرة إلى العمل .

Workplace liquidation clean the workplace, remove the auxiliary material, 
 check the tools and put them to their place , hand-over the works performed to 
 the customer.
